title: Strawberry and Almond Baked Oatmeal
changes_from_base: Sugared strawberries line a baking dish under an oat and flaked-almond layer soaked in an egg and milk custard; it bakes until set with a crunchy almond and brown sugar top, instead of being simmered in a pan.
summary: Juicy strawberries and subtle almond flavour make this baked oatmeal a summer-bright breakfast, tender yet with enough structure to slice neatly.

ingredients.item: unsalted butter, melted, plus a little for the dish
strawberries, hulled and halved (quartered if large)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Preheat oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) and butter a 20 x 28 cm baking dish.

steps.title: Fruit
steps.text: Toss 565 g halved strawberries (quartered if large) with 25 g light brown sugar and spread in the dish.

steps.title: Oats
steps.text: Mix 135 g rolled oats, 35 g flaked almonds, 1 tsp baking powder, ¼ tsp cinnamon and ¼ tsp salt, then scatter over the fruit.

steps.title: Wet
steps.text: Whisk 1 large egg, 420 ml milk, 28 g melted butter, 70 g light brown sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and ¼ tsp almond flavouring; pour over the oats.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Scatter 10 g remaining almonds and 13 g light brown sugar on top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 35-40 min until the top is golden, fruit bubbles at the edges and centre reaches 71 °C.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Let sit for 10 min before serving.

tips: Quarter very large strawberries so they cook evenly with smaller ones.
The bubbling fruit at the edges signals the oatmeal is cooked through.
safety: Check the almond flavouring label to see if it's nut-free, in case of allergies.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days; warm portions individually in the microwave for about 1-2 min. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
